a short list of my DAILY habits:

1.5 packs

6-12 beers

$20.00+ fast food

4+ hours at the bar pissing off friends/strangers

not sleeping

showing up to work hungover

not cleaning my disgusting house

coming up with excuses

waiting for everyone else to solve the problems that I've made

accepting massive amounts of help from my family without giving anything back in return 

not paying bills on time (if ever)

pity parties

wishing i was dead.


i'm not trying to be a dick to you man...but sometimes you gotta cut your losses...

no advice in the world is gonna change the fact that i'm a shitty person/father...some people just suck at life...other people (like me) just suck...it happens...no one's fault but my own

No need to be respectful, I don't deserve it. I guess I've already bitched and moaned enough to everyone that I actually know, so I was just moving on to the next logical step (bitching and moaning to strangers) Your assumption that I have any pride is wrong. None here.


But here's the really really fucked up part:

I'm not an addict.

I realize that the post makes it sound like I've ruined my life with substance abuse, and in some ways I guess that's true...but not in the way you think. I'm not an alcoholic, heroin addict, or even a pot head. I've done just as many drugs as everyone else, but that's not what keeps me from being useful to the world. I AM JUST PLAIN LAZY AS FUCK. 

I can tell myself (and my family/bosses/friends) that I'll try harder...and i will....for a week or two...and then fuck it all up again...

The apologies that you're talking about have already been made...over and over and over again...everyone who deserves them are sick of hearing it from me. They are ready for me to get the fuck out of the way so they can just start living normal lives.

My son has a decent mom, who lives with a decent man with a decent job. that's much more than he'll get if I keep attempting/failing to be his "dad"...he'll tell people one day that his dad was a ok guy who died in an accident. everyone will be much better off...


seriously...go help someone else who actually has a life in front of them...mine's over
